title: Elizabeth Holmes Put Pfizer's Logo on It HERSELF

lines.say: Elizabeth Holmes admitted she put Pfizer's logo on the report herself. She's now serving one hundred twenty-three months.
lines.show: Elizabeth Holmes admitted she put Pfizer's logo on the report herself. She's now serving 123 months.

scene.label: FAKE PFIZER LOGO|SHE ADDED IT HERSELF

lines.say: Prosecutors said she sent Walgreens reports bearing the logos of Pfizer and two other drug companies.
lines.show: Prosecutors said she sent Walgreens reports bearing the logos of Pfizer and two other drug companies.

lines.say: Drug company witnesses testified they never authorized those logos.
Theranos raised more than seven hundred million dollars from investors.
lines.show: Theranos raised more than $700 million from investors.

lines.say: Guilty of defrauding investors. Her sentence was later cut from one hundred thirty-five months to one hundred twenty-three.
lines.show: Guilty of defrauding investors. Her sentence was later cut from 135 months to 123.
